newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stork wins big Shell/Exxon venture order.
newsitem.headline: Stork wins big Shell/Exxon venture order.

text.p: Industrial systems group Stork NV said on Wednesday a consortium of which it was part had signed a long term contract with Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM).
The contract has a total value of one billion guilders and could be raised to three billion through options, Stork said.

The consortium includes Germany's Siemens, Japan's Yokogawa and three Stork subsidiaries. It will renovate equipment and install new installations at NAM's natural gas field in the northern Netherlands.
NAM is a 50-50 joint venture of Royal Dutch/Shell and Exxon of the U.S.

Stork said the technical facilities at the gas field are 25 years old on average and therefore outdated. Its unit Stork GLT signed a preliminary contract for the maintenance deal in November last year.
